title: Use System API action “System State” to retrieve the current system state
summary: Use the System API action labeled “System State” to retrieve the current state of the OptiSweep system. The returned value(s) can be used to determine whether the system is in a shutdown state versus a running state.
when_to_use: When you need to check the current OptiSweep system state (e.g., to understand whether the system is in a shutdown state or a running state) using the System API action “System State”.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the System API action “System State” and interpret the returned current system state as shutdown vs running.
access_or_tools_needed: System API interface that exposes the action labeled “System State”.

access_required: Access to the System API interface that provides the “System State” action.

steps.title: Interpret the returned system state as shutdown vs running
steps.purpose: Use the returned current system state to determine whether the system is in shutdown or running state.
steps.instruction: Review the returned current system state value(s) from “System State” and classify the system as being in a shutdown state versus a running state.
steps.expected_result: You can determine whether the system is in a shutdown state or a running state based on the returned current system state value(s).
steps.healthy_condition: The returned system state value(s) align with the source’s described relationship: System Startup applies to a shutdown state; System Shutdown applies to a running state.
